display_long_description:
Search for your missing family in a world overrun by the undead. The Living Remain is a single-player, story-driven adventure shooter blending intense combat, exploration, and environmental puzzles.

Play as Grant Montgomery, a former soldier, with your ally Alex guiding you over the radio. Scavenge supplies, craft ammo, and upgrade your arsenal as you push through dangerous territory.

# Explore Beyond the Fight
Search your surroundings, navigate hazardous environments, and solve puzzles as you progress through a campaign that blends tense exploration with intense firefights.
[media]

# Hands-On Gunplay
Aim, reload, and swap magazines yourself. Keep your weapons ready as the undead close in and encounters escalate.
[media]

# Upgrade Your Arsenal
Modify your weapons with upgrades including extended magazines and hollow-point ammunition to prepare for the threats ahead.
[media]

# Face the Horde
Fight through close encounters and larger groups of the undead across abandoned streets and industrial interiors.
[media]

# Includes cross-buy with the Rift version.
